target.statement: GTRC at ε=0.05 achieves a median gap of approximately 0.002% to the best observed objective across 34 UCI datasets, using a median of 32 restarts.

compute.basis: 34 UCI datasets, 200 repetitions of GTRC (median 32 restarts) plus fixed-restart baselines; k-means++ on up to 581k points (Cover Type) is CPU-bound and may take hours on 8 cores.

blockers: Code repository may not include exact preprocessing/configs for all 34 datasets
Cover Type (581k points) and other large datasets may be slow on CPU
Exact median gap depends on random seeds and implementation details
title: An interpretable Good--Turing restart criterion for k-means++
